spec_match.rationale: Field vocabulary (state/protocol/cipherSuite/keaGroupName/certificateTransparencyCompliance/isEV) mirrors the extensions SecurityInfo dictionary the chromestatus entry references, but Controlled Frame's exact IDL is still draft and the page works over pasted/simulated JSON since the API only exists inside IWAs.

interactive.rationale: Presets, editable JSON, parse errors, classification badges and certificate-chain analysis (expired/self-signed/expiring-soon) all render correctly; CDP-verified preset switch to 'broken'.

edge_cases.rationale: Malformed JSON, unknown top-level keys, self-signed, expired and CT-non-compliant paths all handled and verified.

references.rationale: chromestatus + Chrome Developers SecurityInfo links present.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Mobile 360x740 DPR3 scrollWidth now 360 (was 608 — the 247px field-table clip); the generated table renders inside a labelled overflow-x:auto region; desktop CDP run confirmed badge/rows; screenshots read; console clean except environmental fonts request.

accessibility.rationale: Preset buttons native; editor labelled; scroll region focusable and labelled.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The worst mobile clip in the feature (247px) is eliminated; both classes verified with screenshots.

openQuestions.title: Track the Controlled Frame SecurityInfo IDL as it stabilises
openQuestions.detail: When the controlledframe spec lands a concrete SecurityInfo dictionary, re-check the field docs (keaGroupName vs keyExchangeGroup naming, validity shape) against it and note any divergences in the field descriptions.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table horizontal scroll container mobile overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content scrolls in its own overflow:auto container; min-width:0 / overflow-wrap on flex-grid items with long unbreakable strings; flex-wrap where overflow is possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped wide tables/readouts in dedicated overflow-x:auto containers (tabindex=0, labelled region) or added min-width:0 + overflow-wrap:anywhere to grid/flex value cells; page scrollWidth measured 360 at 360px viewport after the fix.

summary: Mobile-clip fix for the flagged 247px overflow: the generated field table (fixed 180px key column + value + description) now renders inside a keyboard-focusable overflow-x:auto container; page scrollWidth measured 608 → 360 at the 360px viewport. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
